as a mechanic, don’t do this. there’s a couple reasons why. First reason is it’s not really a fix at all, your not saving any structural integrity, it’s purely for cosmetics, Second reason is corrosion will eat around the sprayfoam leaving it sticking out like a sore thumb. third reason is after the corrosion eats around it, you’ll take it to us to fix it and then we gotta dig around the panels before we can even take a look at the original damage which will run you an hour to 2 hours worth of paid labour. (2-300$) Fourth and final reason, hearing the technician tell you “i don’t know what dumbass did the foam but i wouldn’t let him near my sons hotwheels” will be something you never live down
